 *
 * <p>Blocking private ranges is defence in depth against SSRF if anything server-side ever fetches
 * the URL. Known limitation: DNS rebinding (public at creation, private later); a fetcher would
 * have to resolve and pin the IP itself. Hosts that do not resolve are rejected (fail closed).
 */
public final class UrlValidator {

  private static final Pattern DOTTED_QUAD =
      Pattern.compile(
          "^(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\\d|1\\d\\d|[1-9]?\\d)(\\.(25[0-5]|2[0-4]\\d|1\\d\\d|[1-9]?\\d)){3}$");
  // Decimal (2130706433), short (127.1), octal (0177.0.0.1) or hex (0x7f.1) IPv4 spellings.
  private static final Pattern NUMERIC_HOST =
      Pattern.compile("^(0x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+)(\\.(0x[0-9a-f]+|[0-9]+))*$");

  private final int maxLength;
  private final Set<String> allowedSchemes;
  private final boolean blockPrivateNetworks;
  private final String selfHost;
  private final HostResolver resolver;

  public UrlValidator(
      int maxLength,
      Set<String> allowedSchemes,
      boolean blockPrivateNetworks,
      String baseUrl,
      HostResolver resolver) {
    this.maxLength = maxLength;
    this.allowedSchemes =
        allowedSchemes.stream().map(s -> s.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT)).collect(Collectors.toSet());
    this.blockPrivateNetworks = blockPrivateNetworks;
    this.selfHost = normalizeHost(URI.create(baseUrl).getHost());
    this.resolver = resolver;
  }

  /**
   * Returns the parsed URL (surrounding whitespace stripped) or throws {@link InvalidUrlException}.
   */
  public URI validate(String rawUrl) {
    if (rawUrl == null || rawUrl.isBlank()) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(Reason.MALFORMED, "url is required");
    }
    String url = rawUrl.strip();
    if (url.length() > maxLength) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(
          Reason.TOO_LONG, "url must be at most " + maxLength + " characters");
    }

    URI uri;
    try {
      uri = new URI(url);
    } catch (URISyntaxException e) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(Reason.MALFORMED, "url is not a valid URI");
    }

    String scheme = uri.getScheme() == null ? "" : uri.getScheme().toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    if (!allowedSchemes.contains(scheme)) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(
          Reason.SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED, "scheme must be one of " + allowedSchemes);
    }
    if (uri.getRawUserInfo() != null) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(
          Reason.USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED, "credentials in the URL (user:pass@host) are not allowed");
    }
    if (uri.getHost() == null || uri.getHost().isBlank()) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(Reason.MISSING_HOST, "url must have a valid host");
    }

    String host = normalizeHost(uri.getHost());
    if (host.equals(selfHost)) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(Reason.SELF_REFERENCE, "url must not point at this service");
    }
    if (blockPrivateNetworks) {
      checkPublic(host);
    }
    return uri;
  }

  private void checkPublic(String host) {
    boolean ipv6Literal = host.startsWith("[");
    if (!ipv6Literal
        && NUMERIC_HOST.matcher(host).matches()
        && !DOTTED_QUAD.matcher(host).matches()) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(
          Reason.NON_CANONICAL_IP, "IP addresses must be written as a.b.c.d");
    }

    List<InetAddress> addresses;
    try {
      if (ipv6Literal || DOTTED_QUAD.matcher(host).matches()) {
        // A literal: InetAddress parses it without any DNS lookup.
        addresses = List.of(InetAddress.getByName(host));
      } else {
        addresses = resolver.resolve(host);
      }
    } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
      throw new InvalidUrlException(Reason.UNRESOLVABLE_HOST, "host does not resolve");
    }

    for (InetAddress address : addresses) {
      if (isNonPublic(address)) {
        throw new InvalidUrlException(
            Reason.PRIVATE_ADDRESS, "url must not point at a private or local network address");
      }
    }
  }

  static boolean isNonPublic(InetAddress address) {
    if (address.isAnyLocalAddress()
        || address.isLoopbackAddress()
        || address.isLinkLocalAddress()
        || address.isSiteLocalAddress()
        || address.isMulticastAddress()) {
      return true;
    }
    byte[] b = address.getAddress();
    if (address instanceof Inet4Address) {
      int first = b[0] & 0xff;
      int second = b[1] & 0xff;
      return first == 0 // "this network" 0.0.0.0/8
          || (first == 100 && second >= 64 && second <= 127) // carrier-grade NAT 100.64.0.0/10
          || first >= 240; // reserved 240.0.0.0/4 and broadcast
    }
    if (address instanceof Inet6Address) {
      if ((b[0] & 0xfe) == 0xfc) {
        return true; // unique-local fc00::/7
      }
      // IPv4 embedded in IPv6 (::a.b.c.d compatible form, 64:ff9b::/96 NAT64): check the IPv4 part.
      if (isZero(b, 0, 12) || isNat64Prefix(b)) {
        return isNonPublic(embeddedIpv4(b));
      }
    }
    return false;
  }

  private static boolean isZero(byte[] b, int from, int to) {
    for (int i = from; i < to; i++) {
      if (b[i] != 0) {
        return false;
      }
    }
    return true;
  }

  private static boolean isNat64Prefix(byte[] b) {
    return b[0] == 0x00
        && b[1] == 0x64
        && (b[2] & 0xff) == 0xff
        && (b[3] & 0xff) == 0x9b
        && isZero(b, 4, 12);
  }

  private static InetAddress embeddedIpv4(byte[] b) {
    try {
      return InetAddress.getByAddress(new byte[] {b[12], b[13], b[14], b[15]});
    } catch (UnknownHostException e) {
      throw new IllegalStateException(e); // impossible: 4 bytes is always a valid IPv4 address
    }
  }

  private static String normalizeHost(String host) {
    String h = host == null ? "" : host.toLowerCase(Locale.ROOT);
    return h.endsWith(".") ? h.substring(0, h.length() - 1) : h;
  }
}

/**
 * A destination URL that failed validation. {@link Reason} gives a stable machine-readable cause.
 */
public class InvalidUrlException extends RuntimeException {

  public enum Reason {
    TOO_LONG,
    MALFORMED,
    SCHEME_NOT_ALLOWED,

    USERINFO_NOT_ALLOWED,
    NON_CANONICAL_IP,
    PRIVATE_ADDRESS,
    UNRESOLVABLE_HOST,
    SELF_REFERENCE
  }

  private final Reason reason;

  public InvalidUrlException(Reason reason, String message) {
    super(message);
    this.reason = reason;
  }

  public Reason reason() {
    return reason;
  }

    ShortenerProperties.Alias alias = props.alias();
    return new AliasValidator(
        alias.min(), alias.max(), alias.pattern(), alias.reserved(), links::existsByCodeIgnoreCase);
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.link;

import java.time.Clock;
import java.time.Instant;
import java.time.temporal.ChronoUnit;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Id;
import org.springframework.data.annotation.Version;
import org.springframework.data.relational.core.mapping.Table;

/**
 * A short link. The id comes from {@code link_id_seq} before insert, so Spring Data JDBC decides
 * insert-vs-update from {@code version}: {@code null} means new.
 */
@Table("link")
public record Link(
    @Id Long id,
    String code,
    String originalUrl,
    boolean customAlias,
    LinkStatus status,
    String createdBy,
    Instant createdAt,
    Instant updatedAt,
    @Version Integer version) {

  public static Link newGenerated(
      long id, String code, String originalUrl, String createdBy, Clock clock) {
    Instant now = now(clock);
    return new Link(id, code, originalUrl, false, LinkStatus.ACTIVE, createdBy, now, now, null);
  }

  public static Link newAlias(
      long id, String alias, String originalUrl, String createdBy, Clock clock) {
    Instant now = now(clock);
    return new Link(id, alias, originalUrl, true, LinkStatus.ACTIVE, createdBy, now, now, null);
  }

  public boolean isActive() {
    return status == LinkStatus.ACTIVE;
  }

  /** Soft delete. Idempotent: deleting a deleted link returns it unchanged. */
  public Link markDeleted(Clock clock) {
    if (status == LinkStatus.DELETED) {
      return this;
    }
    return new Link(
        id,
        code,
        originalUrl,
        customAlias,
        LinkStatus.DELETED,
        createdBy,
        createdAt,
        now(clock),
        version);
  }

  /** Postgres timestamptz keeps microseconds; truncating keeps create and read responses equal. */
  private static Instant now(Clock clock) {
    return clock.instant().truncatedTo(ChronoUnit.MICROS);
  }

  // Withers used by Spring Data JDBC to populate generated values on an immutable record.
  Link withVersion(Integer version) {
    return new Link(
        id, code, originalUrl, customAlias, status, createdBy, createdAt, updatedAt, version);
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.link;

import com.acme.shortener.cache.CacheEntry;
import com.acme.shortener.cache.LinkCache;
import com.acme.shortener.code.AliasTakenException;
import com.acme.shortener.code.AliasValidator;
import com.acme.shortener.code.CodeGenerator;
import com.acme.shortener.config.ShortenerProperties;
import com.acme.shortener.url.UrlValidator;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.MeterRegistry;
import io.micrometer.core.instrument.Timer;
import java.net.URI;
import java.time.Clock;
import java.util.Objects;
import org.springframework.dao.DuplicateKeyException;
import org.springframework.stereotype.Service;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronization;
import org.springframework.transaction.support.TransactionSynchronizationManager;

@Service
public class LinkService {

  /** Generated codes are collision-free among themselves; this only covers an alias clash. */
  private static final int MAX_GENERATE_ATTEMPTS = 3;

  private final LinkRepository links;
  private final CodeGenerator codeGenerator;
  private final AliasValidator aliasValidator;
  private final UrlValidator urlValidator;
  private final LinkCache cache;
  private final Clock clock;
  private final String baseUrl;

  // shortener.create / shortener.resolve, tagged by outcome; histograms for p95/p99 (NFR-1).
  private final Timer createCreated;
  private final Timer createFailed;
  private final Timer resolveFound;
  private final Timer resolveNotFound;
  private final Timer resolveError;

  public LinkService(
      LinkRepository links,
      CodeGenerator codeGenerator,
      AliasValidator aliasValidator,
      UrlValidator urlValidator,
      LinkCache cache,
      Clock clock,
      ShortenerProperties properties,
      MeterRegistry meters) {
    this.links = links;
    this.codeGenerator = codeGenerator;
    this.aliasValidator = aliasValidator;
    this.urlValidator = urlValidator;
    this.cache = cache;
    this.clock = clock;
    this.baseUrl = properties.baseUrl();
    this.createCreated = timer(meters, "shortener.create", "created");
    this.createFailed = timer(meters, "shortener.create", "failed");
    this.resolveFound = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "found");
    this.resolveNotFound = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "not_found");
    this.resolveError = timer(meters, "shortener.resolve", "error");
  }

  public LinkResponse create(CreateLinkRequest request, String owner) {
    Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start();
    try {
      URI url = urlValidator.validate(request.url());
      String alias = request.customAlias();
      Link saved =
          (alias == null || alias.isEmpty())
              ? createGenerated(url.toString(), owner)
              : createAlias(alias, url.toString(), owner);
      afterCommit(() -> cache.putFound(saved.code(), saved.originalUrl()));
      sample.stop(createCreated);
      return LinkResponse.of(saved, baseUrl);
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      sample.stop(createFailed);
      throw e;
    }
  }

  /** Redirect target for an active link. Public: no ownership check. Cache, then DB. */
  public URI resolve(String code) {
    Timer.Sample sample = Timer.start();
    CacheEntry entry;
    try {
      entry = cache.get(code).orElseGet(() -> loadIntoCache(code));
    } catch (RuntimeException e) {
      sample.stop(resolveError);
      throw e;
    }
    return switch (entry) {
      case CacheEntry.Found found -> {
        sample.stop(resolveFound);
        yield URI.create(found.originalUrl());
      }
      case CacheEntry.NotFound notFound -> {
        sample.stop(resolveNotFound);
        throw new LinkNotFoundException(code);
      }
    };
  }

  private static Timer timer(MeterRegistry meters, String name, String outcome) {
    return Timer.builder(name)
        .tag("outcome", outcome)
        .publishPercentileHistogram()
        .register(meters);
  }

  private CacheEntry loadIntoCache(String code) {
    return links
        .findByCode(code)
        .filter(Link::isActive)
        .<CacheEntry>map(link -> {
          cache.putFound(code, link.originalUrl());
          return new CacheEntry.Found(link.originalUrl());
        })
        .orElseGet(() -> {
          cache.putNotFound(code);
          return CacheEntry.NOT_FOUND;
        });
  }

  /** Metadata for the owner, including deleted links (status DELETED). */
  public LinkResponse get(String code, String owner) {
    return LinkResponse.of(findOwned(code, owner), baseUrl);
  }

  /** Soft delete. Idempotent: deleting a deleted link succeeds. */
  public void delete(String code, String owner) {
    Link link = findOwned(code, owner);
    if (link.isActive()) {
      links.save(link.markDeleted(clock));
      // KNOWN-ISSUE BF-1: cache not invalidated on delete. A deleted link keeps redirecting from
      // L1/L2 until its cache TTL expires (L1 5m, L2 24h). Seeded on purpose for the brownfield
      // scenario; see docs/known-issues.md. Do not fix outside that scenario.
    }
  }

  /** The link if {@code owner} created it, including deleted ones; otherwise 404. */
  public Link findOwned(String code, String owner) {
    // Another key's link answers 404 too, so existence isn't revealed.
    return links
        .findByCode(code)
        .filter(link -> Objects.equals(link.createdBy(), owner))
        .orElseThrow(() -> new LinkNotFoundException(code));
  }

  private Link createAlias(String alias, String url, String owner) {
    aliasValidator.validate(alias);
    try {
      return links.save(Link.newAlias(links.nextId(), alias, url, owner, clock));
    } catch (
        RuntimeException e) { // DataAccessException, or Spring Data's DbActionExecutionException
      if (isDuplicateKey(e)) {
        throw new AliasTakenException(alias); // lost a race; the unique index decided
      }
      throw e;
    }
  }

  private Link createGenerated(String url, String owner) {
    // Checked before insert rather than caught after: a failed INSERT aborts the surrounding
    // Postgres transaction (the idempotency transaction), so it can't be retried in place.
    for (int attempt = 1; attempt <= MAX_GENERATE_ATTEMPTS; attempt++) {
      CodeGenerator.GeneratedCode next = codeGenerator.next();
      if (links.findByCode(next.code()).isEmpty()) {
        return links.save(Link.newGenerated(next.id(), next.code(), url, owner, clock));
      }
      // A custom alias already uses this exact code; take the next id.
    }
    throw new IllegalStateException("could not allocate a free code");
  }

  /** Runs after the surrounding transaction commits, or now if there is none. */
  private static void afterCommit(Runnable action) {
    if (TransactionSynchronizationManager.isSynchronizationActive()) {
      TransactionSynchronizationManager.registerSynchronization(
          new TransactionSynchronization() {
            @Override
            public void afterCommit() {
              action.run();
            }
          });
    } else {
      action.run();
    }
  }

  private static boolean isDuplicateKey(Throwable e) {
    for (Throwable t = e; t != null; t = t.getCause()) {
      if (t instanceof DuplicateKeyException) {
        return true;
      }
    }
    return false;
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.api;

import java.net.URI;

/** Stable Problem Details {@code type} URIs. Changing one is a breaking API change. */
public final class ProblemTypes {

  public record Type(URI uri, String title) {}

  public static final Type VALIDATION_FAILED = type("validation-failed", "Validation failed");
  public static final Type MALFORMED_REQUEST = type("malformed-request", "Malformed request");
  public static final Type INVALID_URL = type("invalid-url", "Invalid URL");
  public static final Type INVALID_ALIAS = type("invalid-alias", "Invalid alias");
  public static final Type INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY =
      type("invalid-idempotency-key", "Invalid Idempotency-Key");
  public static final Type UNAUTHORIZED = type("unauthorized", "Unauthorized");
  public static final Type LINK_NOT_FOUND = type("link-not-found", "Link not found");
  public static final Type ALIAS_TAKEN = type("alias-taken", "Alias already taken");
  public static final Type IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED =
      type("idempotency-key-reused", "Idempotency-Key reused with a different request");
  public static final Type INVALID_STATS_RANGE = type("invalid-stats-range", "Invalid stats range");
  public static final Type RATE_LIMITED = type("rate-limited", "Too many requests");
  public static final Type INTERNAL_ERROR = type("internal-error", "Internal error");

  private ProblemTypes() {}

  private static Type type(String slug, String title) {
    return new Type(URI.create("/problems/" + slug), title);
  }
}

package com.acme.shortener.api;

import com.acme.shortener.analytics.InvalidStatsRangeException;
import com.acme.shortener.auth.ApiKeyAuthInterceptor;
import com.acme.shortener.auth.UnauthorizedException;
import com.acme.shortener.code.AliasTakenException;
import com.acme.shortener.code.InvalidAliasException;
import com.acme.shortener.idempotency.IdempotencyKeyReusedException;
import com.acme.shortener.idempotency.InvalidIdempotencyKeyException;
import com.acme.shortener.link.LinkNotFoundException;
import com.acme.shortener.ratelimit.RateLimitHeaders;
import com.acme.shortener.ratelimit.RateLimitedException;
import com.acme.shortener.url.InvalidUrlException;
import jakarta.servlet.http.HttpServletRequest;
import java.net.URI;
import java.util.List;
import java.util.Map;
import org.slf4j.Logger;
import org.slf4j.LoggerFactory;
import org.slf4j.MDC;
import org.springframework.beans.TypeMismatchException;
import org.springframework.http.HttpHeaders;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatus;
import org.springframework.http.HttpStatusCode;
import org.springframework.http.ProblemDetail;
import org.springframework.http.ResponseEntity;
import org.springframework.http.converter.HttpMessageNotReadableException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.MethodArgumentNotValidException;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.ExceptionHandler;
import org.springframework.web.bind.annotation.RestControllerAdvice;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.ServletWebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.context.request.WebRequest;
import org.springframework.web.servlet.mvc.method.annotation.ResponseEntityExceptionHandler;

/**
 * Maps exceptions to RFC 9457 Problem Details. Each error has a stable {@code type} URI that
 * clients (and agent-written tests) can assert on. See {@link ProblemTypes}.
 */
@RestControllerAdvice
class ProblemDetailsHandler extends ResponseEntityExceptionHandler {

  private static final Logger log = LoggerFactory.getLogger(ProblemDetailsHandler.class);

  @ExceptionHandler(InvalidUrlException.class)
  ProblemDetail invalidUrl(InvalidUrlException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    ProblemDetail problem =
        problem(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ProblemTypes.INVALID_URL, e.getMessage(), request);
    problem.setProperty("reason", e.reason().name());
    return problem;
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(InvalidAliasException.class)
  ProblemDetail invalidAlias(InvalidAliasException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ProblemTypes.INVALID_ALIAS, e.getMessage(), request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(InvalidIdempotencyKeyException.class)
  ProblemDetail invalidIdempotencyKey(
      InvalidIdempotencyKeyException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(
        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ProblemTypes.INVALID_IDEMPOTENCY_KEY, e.getMessage(), request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(UnauthorizedException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> unauthorized(UnauthorizedException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED)
        .header(
            HttpHeaders.WWW_AUTHENTICATE, "ApiKey header=\"" + ApiKeyAuthInterceptor.HEADER + "\"")
        .body(problem(HttpStatus.UNAUTHORIZED, ProblemTypes.UNAUTHORIZED, e.getMessage(), request));
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(LinkNotFoundException.class)
  ProblemDetail notFound(LinkNotFoundException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(HttpStatus.NOT_FOUND, ProblemTypes.LINK_NOT_FOUND, e.getMessage(), request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(AliasTakenException.class)
  ProblemDetail aliasTaken(AliasTakenException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(HttpStatus.CONFLICT, ProblemTypes.ALIAS_TAKEN, e.getMessage(), request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(IdempotencyKeyReusedException.class)
  ProblemDetail idempotencyKeyReused(IdempotencyKeyReusedException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(
        HttpStatus.UNPROCESSABLE_CONTENT,
        ProblemTypes.IDEMPOTENCY_KEY_REUSED,
        e.getMessage(),
        request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(InvalidStatsRangeException.class)
  ProblemDetail invalidStatsRange(InvalidStatsRangeException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return problem(
        HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST, ProblemTypes.INVALID_STATS_RANGE, e.getMessage(), request);
  }

  @ExceptionHandler(RateLimitedException.class)
  ResponseEntity<ProblemDetail> rateLimited(RateLimitedException e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.status(HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS)
        .headers(RateLimitHeaders.of(e.decision()))
        .body(
            problem(
                HttpStatus.TOO_MANY_REQUESTS, ProblemTypes.RATE_LIMITED, e.getMessage(), request));
  }

  /** Last resort. Logged with the stack trace; the client never sees internals. */
  @ExceptionHandler(Exception.class)
  ProblemDetail unexpected(Exception e, HttpServletRequest request) {
    log.error("Unhandled error on {} {}", request.getMethod(), request.getRequestURI(), e);
    return problem(
        HttpStatus.INTERNAL_SERVER_ERROR,
        ProblemTypes.INTERNAL_ERROR,
        "an unexpected error occurred",
        request);
  }

  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleMethodArgumentNotValid(
      MethodArgumentNotValidException e,
      HttpHeaders headers,
      HttpStatusCode status,
      WebRequest request) {
    ProblemDetail problem =
        problem(
            HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
            ProblemTypes.VALIDATION_FAILED,
            "request has invalid fields",
            servletRequest(request));
    List<Map<String, String>> errors =
        e.getBindingResult().getFieldErrors().stream()
            .map(f ->
                Map.of(
                    "field",
                    f.getField(),
                    "message",
                    f.getDefaultMessage() == null ? "invalid" : f.getDefaultMessage()))
            .toList();
    problem.setProperty("errors", errors);
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest().body(problem);
  }

  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleHttpMessageNotReadable(
      HttpMessageNotReadableException e,
      HttpHeaders headers,
      HttpStatusCode status,
      WebRequest request) {
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
        .body(
            problem(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                ProblemTypes.MALFORMED_REQUEST,
                "request body is missing or is not valid JSON",
                servletRequest(request)));
  }

  /** A query or path parameter of the wrong type, e.g. {@code ?from=yesterday}. */
  @Override
  protected ResponseEntity<Object> handleTypeMismatch(
      TypeMismatchException e, HttpHeaders headers, HttpStatusCode status, WebRequest request) {
    String name = e.getPropertyName() == null ? "parameter" : "'" + e.getPropertyName() + "'";
    return ResponseEntity.badRequest()
        .body(
            problem(
                HttpStatus.BAD_REQUEST,
                ProblemTypes.VALIDATION_FAILED,
                name + " has an invalid value",
                servletRequest(request)));
  }

  private static ProblemDetail problem(
      HttpStatus status, ProblemTypes.Type type, String detail, HttpServletRequest request) {
    ProblemDetail problem = ProblemDetail.forStatusAndDetail(status, detail);
    problem.setType(type.uri());
    problem.setTitle(type.title());
    problem.setInstance(URI.create(request.getRequestURI()));
    String correlationId = MDC.get(CorrelationIdFilter.MDC_KEY);
    if (correlationId != null) {
      problem.setProperty("correlationId", correlationId); // matches the logs for this request
    }
    return problem;
  }

  private static HttpServletRequest servletRequest(WebRequest request) {
    return ((ServletWebRequest) request).getRequest();
  }
